# Artemis HTTP transport — hardware transcript, 2026-11-01

Console: retail Switch 2, firmware 23.0.1, Seedsow Lullaby Demo 1.0.0, Artemis
Launcher installed. HTTP server started with button Y. **No ns2jb RPC session
was used.** The console address is written as `$CONSOLE`; the account uid is not
recorded here.

## 1. Connection and Lua

```
$ node tools/artemis-http.cjs health --host $CONSOLE
status   200  nora2hax/seedsow HTTP server
lua      Lua 5.1
platform Ounce
engine   userdata

$ node tools/artemis-http.cjs eval --host $CONSOLE --code 'print("hello world")'
hello world

$ node tools/artemis-http.cjs eval --host $CONSOLE --code 'print(_VERSION); print(_G.n2h.platform)'
Lua 5.1
Ounce
```

## 2. Uploads

```
text.txt       41 bytes  de4f9d6de5c0f18f988f31bc267ab415ae8700277f411150ae92b4d4661ccccc
bin-4096.bin 4096 bytes  e87d333e5f9dc3d12c4e6445700267dcebf57d156ebece144915a0a3742c44cb
bin-16384.bin 16384 bytes cb158df680b8ead69b547ca78deef580b70947827a4ea23210e09987866a4d16
bin-65536.bin 65536 bytes 5cccb2465cf3b2a34201823de07586a765b009cba96601d684228250c9b3eebd
```

The 65536-byte file exceeds the server body cap and was sent as a first `/save`
chunk followed by `/eval` appends; the other two used `/save` directly.

## 3. Downloads

Every file was downloaded with 4 KiB hex reads, a per-chunk hash and a final
SHA-256, then compared byte-for-byte with the local source:

```
text.txt       downloaded 41    sha256 de4f9d6d…  MATCH
bin-4096.bin   downloaded 4096  sha256 e87d333e…  MATCH
bin-16384.bin  downloaded 16384 sha256 cb158df6…  MATCH
bin-65536.bin  downloaded 65536 sha256 5cccb246…  MATCH
```

The binary fixtures contain NUL, 0xFF and 0x80 at fixed offsets; the comparison
is `cmp`, not just the hash.

## 4. Errors and refusals

```
stat present  -> present 41 bytes
stat missing  -> absent
get missing   -> FAILED[ENOENT] ... exit 9
put core.lua  -> FAILED[EPROTECTED] ... exit 9
rm save9999.dat -> FAILED[EPROTECTED] ... exit 9
put save:/../escape -> FAILED[EPATH] ... exit 9
```

## 5. Atomic rename probe

```
{
  "rename": { "ok": false, "reason": "save:/.ns2http-probe-a: Operation not permitted",
              "overwrote": false },
  "serverBodyCap": 28672
}
```

`os.rename` on `save:/` is refused, so chunked uploads are written directly and
are **not atomic**. `put --atomic` refuses with `EATOMIC` and removes its
temporary file; the target is left absent.

## 6. Explicit-file backup

```
$ node tools/artemis-http.cjs backup --host $CONSOLE --out backup/
explicit-file backup: 9 files, 114443 bytes -> backup/
scope is explicit-files; complete=false
```

Entries include `core.lua 54d25862dc0d7969…`, `inject.iet bf79a739584de93d…`
and `save9999.dat ca47241097a25061…`, matching the staged payload.

## 7. Relaunch

Marker uploaded, game fully closed (HOME -> X -> A) and relaunched, Y pressed:

```
health: 200, Lua 5.1, Ounce
marker downloaded: 35 bytes, sha256 62c9a3fc… — exact content
bin-65536 downloaded: 65536 bytes, sha256 5cccb246… — MATCH
```

## 8. Cleanup

All five disposable files deleted with read-back verification:

```
deleted hw-text.txt; read-back confirms absent
deleted hw-bin-4096.bin; ...
deleted hw-bin-16384.bin; ...
deleted hw-bin-65536.bin; ...
deleted hw-persist.txt; ...
stat -> absent (all five); probe scratch names also absent
```

## 9. Legacy migration using the HTTP snapshot

The HTTP backup is read-only evidence, not a rollback baseline. It was used to
migrate the pre-receipt installation:

```
$ ARTEMIS_STATE=<local state> node tools/artemis-launcher.cjs migrate-legacy \
    --title 010042d022aea000 --uid <full-uid> \
    --backup <pre-install backup> --snapshot backup/ --confirm-migration
migration attestation written: ...original.json
rollback baseline: <pre-install backup> (pre-install, unchanged)
identity evidence: config/uids.json
installed payload verified against pinned b9e6de8… and the deterministic trigger
transformation.
```

The original backup's `manifest.json` SHA-256 before and after migration was
`ea2a2ab0c0cb27be…` — unchanged. The record points at the pre-install trigger
`d149d71bf87f1608…`, while the installed trigger verified as `ca47241097a25061…`.

Negative checks:

```
$ ... --uid <wrong-account>
FAILED: migration refuses: provenance is not established
  no independently verified account identity evidence   (exit 6)

$ ... --snapshot <backup with tampered core.lua>
FAILED: migration refuses: provenance is not established
  /core.lua does not match the pinned release           (exit 6)
```

## 10. Enumeration probe

```
io.open("save:/","rb")      -> file handle
f:read("*a")                -> nil (cannot read a directory)
getmetatable(_G.e).__index  -> function (not enumerable)
```

No complete save listing exists over the current API. Backups are therefore
explicit-file, not complete archives, and cannot authorize a destructive full
restore.

## 11. Remote-verified uploads — 2026-11-01 23:21

The upload path now reads the file back over `/eval` and compares its SHA-256
with the local source before reporting success. Hardware run, no RPC session:

```
$ node tools/artemis-http.cjs put --host $CONSOLE --path save:/v-text.txt --in text.txt
uploaded 23 bytes -> save:/v-text.txt  sha256 d765ef6e5cb123ba…  (remote read-back verified)

v-bin-4096.bin   4096 bytes  eecee203ffa2b470…  (remote read-back verified)
v-bin-16384.bin 16384 bytes  5519aa0a79bf39b5…  (remote read-back verified)
v-bin-65536.bin 65536 bytes  5ee317fd75c476b9…  (remote read-back verified)

$ ... --no-verify
uploaded 23 bytes -> save:/v-unverified.txt  sha256 d765ef6e5cb123ba…  (unverified)
```

Each file was then downloaded with the expected SHA-256, compared with `cmp`,
and deleted with read-back confirmation:

```
text.txt       23 bytes MATCH d765ef6e5cb123bae5ed2cdcd706b6adb676953eb83e2b731dbb74771e948997
bin-4096.bin 4096 bytes MATCH eecee203ffa2b470e17a21134983e05de12f41ff801c6e08e12e771befb67d41
bin-16384.bin 16384 bytes MATCH 5519aa0a79bf39b5156c01563bdaba0d37c49a8d428dc818d325555c479d26fd
bin-65536.bin 65536 bytes MATCH 5ee317fd75c476b98956d4f2437a47ed40ac442a64fc8516bac82fa0bc38e8fc
deleted v-text.txt, v-bin-4096.bin, v-bin-16384.bin, v-bin-65536.bin, v-unverified.txt
stat -> absent (all four checked)
```

An interrupted upload and a failed PUT (both covered offline) are reported as
`EINCOMPLETE` with the partial byte count; a corrupted remote copy is refused
with `EHASH`; a failed write is attempted once, never retried.

## 12. Randomized probe, path validation and transfers — 2026-11-01 23:36

No RPC session. Scratch names use 128-bit random suffixes; ownership is checked
by reading the content back before cleanup.

```
$ node tools/artemis-http.cjs probe --host $CONSOLE
{
  "rename": {
    "ok": false,
    "reason": "rename unsupported or interrupted: save:/.ns2http-probe-b1db…-a: Operation not permitted",
    "names": {
      "a": ".ns2http-probe-b1db5f225adb4d3763f4152a458853fb-a",
      "b": ".ns2http-probe-b1db5f225adb4d3763f4152a458853fb-b"
    },
    "cleaned": ["…-b", "…-a"],
    "left": [],
    "cleanupError": null,
    "collided": null
  },
  "serverBodyCap": 28672
}
stat .ns2http-probe-b1db…-a -> absent
stat .ns2http-probe-b1db…-b -> absent
```

Path validation (rejected locally, no HTTP request):

```
stat save:/../system.dat  -> FAILED[EPATH] parent traversal (exit 9)
put  save:/../escape      -> FAILED[EPATH] parent traversal (exit 9)
put  save:/core.lua       -> FAILED[EPROTECTED] (exit 9)
rm   save:/save9999.dat   -> FAILED[EPROTECTED] (exit 9)
```

Verified binary transfers (remote read-back hash, download hash, `cmp`, delete):


Relaunch (HOME -> X -> A), press Y again:
